paragraphs: I design, build, and study AI systems that genuinely work with people. My research asks: how do humans make sense of AI, and how can we design interactions that feel trustworthy, transparent, and human?
I'm a PhD student advised by Prof. [Advisor] at [University], affiliated with [Lab Name]. Before grad school, I studied [background].
